text:
Lena: quick idea from usability: surface a tiny 'mini-rail' on the left edge of streaming replies that shows light pulses when new chunks arrive so users can watch progress without a big flashing UI. :zap:
Maya P: love the low-profile approach. what do you mean by pulses — one per chunk or a single heartbeat?
Lena: one pulse per chunk, but super subtle (8px height, 2px width, fade 100ms). call it the "signal pulse" in the spec.
Devon: backend already tags chunk boundaries. we can add `signal: true` on the stream events. cheap to render.
Arjun (design): naming: let's avoid "dot"/"pulse" in user-facing copy. in docs call it "signal pulse" and in CSS `--signal-pulse`. accessibility: ensure it's not the only cue; pair with `aria-live` text for screen readers: "Partial output available".
a11y-bot: checklist: 1) ensure ARIA role=status/aria-live=polite for partial outputs, 2) pulses disabled for `prefers-reduced-motion`, 3) color contrast not the sole indicator.
Maya P: UX actions — propose a single compact control: a toggle menu with two verbs: "Halt" and "Regenerate". tooltip copy: "Halt generation and keep partial" and "Regenerate from scratch". preference: verb-first.
Devon: mapping: client sends `stop` for Halt; Regenerate triggers a fresh `create` with previous prompt. we can expose `remaining_tokens_hint` as an integer in events so UI can show "~120 to finish".
Arjun (design): also proposing a tiny token odometer to the right of the composer showing "used · est" like `12 · ~140`. hover expands to sparkline of tokens/sec. make it low-contrast to avoid grabbing attention.
Maya P: alt text for odometer: "Tokens used X, estimated remaining Y". confirm translations read natural with dot separator.
Lena: prompt library tweak — a "prompt cassette": horizontal scroll of pinned prompts under composer, compact by default during streaming and expandable. pinned prompts should be keyboard reachable.
Arjun (design): animate cassette collapse but disable for reduced-motion. pinned state has small pin icon and `aria-pressed` true.
Devon: dev notes: feature flag `mini_rail_stream_v1`. events: `chunk_signal: bool`, `chunk_id: int`, `remaining_tokens_hint: int`, `partial_token_count: int`. client computes tokens/sec from chunk timestamps.
a11y-bot: recommend announcing "Partial output available" when first chunk arrives and "Generation halted" when user halts. provide focus management to moved elements.
Maya P: microcopy check: prefer "Halt" over "Stop" in quick tests? run 6-person panel. also test "Regenerate" vs "Try again".
Lena: ok i'll prototype frames and a short test. Arjun, can you drop assets in Figma and name the layer `signal-pulse`?
Arjun (design): will push frames: https://redwood.design/figma/playground/mini-rail (frames 8-11).
Maya P: I'll run microcopy by EOD.
deploy-bot: sandbox build 2026-06-02T10:03:21 deployed (featureflag: mini_rail_stream_v1).
